summary.content:
Today's selection covers 109 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 66 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: U.S. Soldier Gets 70 Months in Prison for AT&T, Verizon Extortions
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 60 articles published in the last 24 hours
